_comment: SYNAPSE Console — mutation gate per CLAUDE.md: <15% survival on rewards-adjacent (>=85% killed), <10% on guardrails (>=90% killed). Targets the load-bearing TS paths: canonical JSON (I-13), full-jitter retry (FE-INV-006/ADR-016), HTTP client (FE-INV-002, 012), WebSocket multiplex (FE-INV-008), replay determinism (FE-INV-028), confidence (FE-INV-005), auth refresh, and override-state stores. UI components are tested via Storybook a11y + visual regression, not mutation.
_thresholds_comment: WS-9: break set to 50 as the initial mechanical floor. Was null (informational). Ratchet plan: 50 (this PR) -> 65 (after json-canonical + jitter-retry tests land) -> 80 (post WS-10) -> 85 (CLAUDE.md target: <15% survival = >=85% killed). Each PR that lowers the survival rate may also bump `break` by 5; PRs that raise it bounce in review. Never set back to null — that's the regression we're fixing.
